Name: Shadow Milk Cookie FS
Author: BlueJestar
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/7NQw0zB.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]Shadow Milk Cookie is a fictional character from the popular mobile game Cookie Run: Kingdom.

This mod allows you to equip custom clothing from the Fashion Sense mirror that will make your player look like Shadow Milk Cookie! This mod does not affect any actual gameplay, only the appearance. [/center]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]﻿

STEP 1) Click "Manual" and then "Slow Download"
STEP 2) Once downloaded, extract the file
Step 3) Move the extracted file into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]

Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer
[*]No known mod conflicts
[/list]
